home.title: Corpinot - Personal Thoughts, Shared Openly
home.description: Personal thoughts shared openly on Corpinot
home.intro:
I'm a French developer with a deep appetite for learning, exploring paths less traveled. I've spent a lot of time working on Verbatims and Zimablue, and I have four more projects in the pipeline.

I've worked at Dassault Systèmes, Servier, and Fabernovel. Today, I'm exploring my own voice.

I've been coding since I was a kid. Here, I share my experiments, failures, and lessons learned, as well as the works of art that have left a mark on me.

Enjoy your visit, and thanks for reading.
